recentItems.title: Mitochondria: How communication shapes our future | Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski | TEDxMedUniGraz
recentItems.description:
Right now, a conversation is running inside your cells that began 1.5 billion years ago, and it may decide how you age. Mitochondria, the bacteria-turned-power-plants of our cells, constantly exchange signals with their neighbors through energy, reactive oxygen species, and calcium, but with age this exchange doesn’t fade, it overheats. Molecular biologist Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski shows what goes wrong in this conversation and why learning to keep it fine-tuned might be the key to healthy aging. Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski is a molecular biologist and Professor at the Gottfried Schatz Research Center, Medical University of Graz, where she serves as Deputy Head of the Division of Molecular Biology and Biochemistry. Her research explores how mitochondria communicate with the rest of the cell — and how that communication changes as we age.
After her Ph.D., she conducted research at various institutions including ETH Zurich and Les Laboratoires Servier (Paris), before starting her own group in Graz. With her team, she uses cutting-edge fluorescence microscopy across various aging models to understand the cellular processes that drive age-related diseases.
Funded by multiple FWF grants, she has received honors including the Elisabeth Lutz Prize (Austrian Academy of Sciences) and the Award of Excellence from Austria's Ministry of Education and Research. 
She's also active in science communication and published *Der Code zum Jungbleiben*. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: From Helped to Helpers: Rewriting Ability | Moses Chowdari Gorrepati | TEDxKLH University Bowrampet
recentItems.description:
For too long, society has viewed disability through the narrow lens of sympathy, reducing extraordinary human potential to a narrative of charity. In From Helped to Helpers: Rewriting the Story of Disability, Moses Chowdari of EnAble India challenges this outdated perspective through three powerful real-life stories of individuals with disabilities who did more than overcome barriers they went on to lead, build, and empower others. It is a compelling call to replace pity with possibility and rethink how we recognize capability, dignity, and the invaluable contributions of people with disabilities.

With sincere gratitude to our Principal, University Management, Faculty Coordinators, Core Organizing Team, Student Volunteers, and Sponsors, we extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who supported us in bringing this event to life. Your guidance, dedication, and unwavering encouragement made this journey possible.

TEDxKLH University Bowrampet Licensee & Organizer - Bobba Thambi Aashish
 Moses Chowdari Gorrepati is a social impact leader dedicated to advancing disability inclusion and creating meaningful employment opportunities for persons with disabilities. With over 14 years of experience in the disability inclusion sector, he has worked to expand access to livelihoods, build inclusive workplaces, and develop digital literacy initiatives. As a leader at EnAble India, he contributes to efforts that challenge conventional perceptions of disability and promote economic independence, dignity, and participation. His work has been recognised through the NCPEDP–Mindtree Helen Keller Award and the Sarojini Trilok Nath National Award for his contributions to disability inclusion and empowerment. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Kendin Hakkında Bilmediğin Ne Var? | Begüm KOCAEFE | TEDxAtapark
recentItems.description: Kendi gücünü ve neleri başarabileceğinin farkında mısın? "Muhtaç olduğun kudret damarlarındaki asil kanda mevcuttur." İstanbul doğumlu olup İstanbul Üniversitesi İletişim Fakültesi Gazetecilik Bölümü'nden mezun olmuş, aynı üniversitede Sosyoloji eğitimine devam etmiştir. 2003 yılında Dışbank'ta çalışma hayatına başlamış, bankanın Fortis'e dönüşmesiyle Kalite ve Eğitim Bölümü'nde görev almıştır. 2012 yılında Contact Center World yarışmasında EMEA bölge birincisi, dünya ikincisi olmuştur.2013 yılında İzmir'e yerleşerek eğitim ve danışmanlık alanında çalışmaya başlamıştır. 2018 yılında kendi kurduğu İncir Eğitim ve Danışmanlık bünyesinde eğitim faaliyetlerini sürdürmeye başlamıştır. Aynı zamanda Erickson koçu olan Kocaefe, toplumsal sorumluluk projelerinde gönüllü koçluk yapmakta ve Posta Gazetesi'nde köşe yazarlığı yapmıştır. Eğitim,iletişim,nörobilim ve kişisel gelişim alanlarında çalışmalarını sürdürmektedir. recentItems.title: The Courage to Be a Beginner Again | Tom Solo | TEDxEssen
recentItems.description: In The Courage to Be a Beginner Again, Tom Solo explores how resilience is not just about overcoming adversity, but about embracing uncertainty and finding the courage to reinvent ourselves. Drawing on his personal journey from craftsman to photographer, voice actor, and entrepreneur, he shares how curiosity, creativity, concentration, and courage can turn new beginnings into opportunities for growth. Tom Solo is a German artist, creative entrepreneur, and investor whose unconventional career has taken him from award-winning craftsmanship to international photography and collaborations with some of the world's leading brands and film studios as a voice actor. Driven by curiosity and creativity, he connects the worlds of art, business, and innovation, turning bold ideas into meaningful opportunities. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Bildiklerini Küçümseme Hikayen Orada Başlıyor | Ayşe ŞEN ŞİMŞEK | TEDxAtapark
recentItems.description:
Çocuğunun rahatsızlığını çözememesiyle başlayan bir arayış, üretim süreci ve geldiği nokta. Çivril'in küçük bir köyünden Avrupa'ya açılan bir çiftçilik ve üreticilik hikayesi  Denizlinin bir koyunde yasamakta ancak aslen Yayladağlı'dır. Çiftçi bir ailenin kızıdır. Anne ve babası o küçükken boşanmıştır. Annesi, Ayşe Şen lise son sınıftayken kanserden vefat etmiştir. Üniversite bitmeden evlenip Ege'ye taşınır. Bir süre egenin köyünde kayınvalidesi ve kayınpederiyle çiftçilik yapar. Sonra akaryakıt bayisinde işe girer ve 7 yıl orada çalışır. Burada muhasebe öğrenir. Sonra fabrikada çalışmaya başlar. İzin günlerinde bağ bahçeyle uğraşmaya devam eder.
Oğlu dünyaya gelir. Oğlu çok sık hastalandığı çeşitli vitaminler vs kullanmaya başlar. Ancak hastalığı geçmez anneannesinin peynir tarifini öğrenir ve oğluna yapar. O peynirden sonra oğlunun sık hastalanma durumu geçer. Zaman
içinde Ayşe Şen Şimşek, öğrendiği tarifleri diğer annelerle buluşturmak ister. Doğal reçeller, erişteler vs yapmaya başlar.
Rahmetli kayınvalidesinin 30 metrelik mutfağında yapmaya başladığı, ona kimsenin inanmadığı bir serüvene şu an 7 kadın çalışanıyla devam etmektedir This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. recentItems.title: How to Alchemize Stigma within a Falling Sky  | Skye Berger | TEDxGary
recentItems.description:
Skye Berger takes the "sky is falling" moments of life to a level of engagement and understanding that invites you to fold strife into your success equation. She teaches that everything happening in your life happens to make you whole.
 Playwright, astrologer, Reiki master, sound healer whose work lives in intersection of the cosmos, the body, and community transformation. A lifelong student of cycles and an Intimacy Professional, she holds space for others to come home to themselves weaving systems thinking and soul work into one human practice. Through The Skye Webb Walker Simulation, she creates multidisciplinary works that ask souls to seek their center. This Story Telling Slam is a culmination of curating Afrofuturist healing praxis, her body of work spans original theater, cooperative game design, and civic arts organizing. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Visible Stories Can Create Space For Other Voices | Kristen Zamora | TEDxGary
recentItems.description:
Kristin Zamora knows what it means to paint on purpose and for a purpose. Her idea grew into a practice where she uses paint to reveal past trauma and hurt. Her courage empowers others to release, reveal, and heal together through the shared act of creating.
 Kristen Zamora is an artist, speaker, and creator of Healing Through Body Art, an immersive storytelling project that uses symbolic body painting to help people transform deeply personal experiences into visible works of art. For more than a decade, Kristen has explored the intersection of creativity, vulnerability, and human connection. Through her work, participants collaborate to express experiences that often feel impossible to describe with words alone. 
Their stories are painted onto the body, not as decoration, but as symbols of resilience, identity, grief, hope, and transformation. At the end of each experience, the artwork is washed away, marking not an ending, but the beginning of a new chapter. Kristen’s work has been featured at ArtPrize and recognized by WOOD TV8’s Remarkable Woman program for its impact on individuals and the community. She has shared her work through conferences, workshops, and schols. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: From One Frame to Twenty-Four: Unbroken Passion | Phani Gogireddy | TEDxKLH University Bowrampet
recentItems.description:
A single photograph captures a fleeting moment, but building a lasting creative enterprise demands the courage to weather the storms behind the lens. In From One Frame to Twenty-Four: Scaling Passion Through Personal Struggle, Phani Gogireddy shares his journey of transforming a personal passion for photography into a thriving creative enterprise. From Navigating personal challenges, financial uncertainty, and moments of profound self-doubt, he reveals how every setback became an opportunity for growth and reinvention. His story is a powerful reminder that true metamorphosis happens when you refuse to let life's struggles dim your creative vision and continue building on what you believe in.

With sincere gratitude to our Principal, University Management, Faculty Coordinators, Core Organizing Team, Student Volunteers, and Sponsors, we extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who supported us in bringing this event to life. Your guidance, dedication, and unwavering encouragement made this journey possible.

TEDxKLH University Bowrampet Licensee & Organizer - Bobba Thambi Aashish Phani Gogireddy is a Director of Photography, filmmaker, and entrepreneur who transformed his passion for visual storytelling into a thriving creative enterprise. Beginning his journey in Hyderabad in 2016 with one camera and two computers, he built 24 Frames into a recognised luxury wedding photography and cinematography brand in South India. With roots in the Telugu film industry, Phani combines cinematic artistry with entrepreneurial vision to create compelling visual experiences. An Official Nikon India Influencer, PPIN National Advisor, and APPVWA Advisor, he continues to contribute to the photography and filmmaking community. His journey reflects the power of vision, perseverance, and the courage to build something meaningful from humble beginnings. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: When Everyone Walks Away, Build Anyway | Madhulash Babu Krovvidi | TEDxKLH University Bowrampet
recentItems.description:
Having big dreams without a roadmap can be terrifying, especially when your earliest ideas fail and the very team you trusted walks away in pursuit of safer opportunities. In When Everyone Walks Away, Build Anyway, Madhulash of Edodwaja shares the raw, unfiltered story of battling crippling self-doubt and navigating complete isolation long before government support and media recognition came his way. What emerged from that struggle was more than just a venture; it was a mission to bring technology into rural classrooms. His journey is a powerful reminder that true metamorphosis begins when you find the courage to keep going, even when nobody is left standing beside you.

With sincere gratitude to our Principal, University Management, Faculty Coordinators, Core Organizing Team, Student Volunteers, and Sponsors, we extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who supported us in bringing this event to life. Your guidance, dedication, and unwavering encouragement made this journey possible. 

TEDxKLH University Bowrampet Licensee & Organizer - Bobba Thambi Aashish Madhulash Babu is an entrepreneur and social innovator, and the founder of the Edodwaja Foundation. He is the driving force behind the FLOW Bus (Futuristic Lab On Wheels), a solar-powered mobile innovation lab bringing hands-on technology education to students in rural India. Through this initiative, he has reached over 60,000 students, inspiring young minds to explore technology, embrace innovation and imagine a future beyond limitations. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
